title: No Study Rooms Left
transcript:
Student: Hi, I'd like to book a group study room for tonight.
Librarian: Let me check. I'm afraid they're all taken until ten. It's midterm week.
Student: Ugh, I should've seen that coming. Is there anywhere else we could go?
Librarian: The fourth floor has open tables, and it's usually quiet after seven.
Student: We need to practice a presentation, though. We'll be talking a lot.
Librarian: Then try the media lab in the basement. It isn't on the booking system, so people forget about it.
Student: Oh, perfect. Thanks!

questions.stem: Why does the student say, "I should've seen that coming"?
options: He noticed a sign saying the rooms were closed.
He realizes the rooms are always busy during exams.
He was warned by a friend about the library.
He expected the librarian to be unhelpful.
questions.explanation: The librarian mentions it's midterm week, and the student realizes he should have expected the rooms to be full.

questions.stem: Why does the librarian recommend the media lab?
options: It has better equipment than the study rooms.
It stays open later than the rest of the library.
It is the only room that can be reserved online.
It suits a group that needs to talk out loud.
questions.explanation: The student says the group will be talking a lot, so the quiet fourth floor won't work, and the librarian suggests the media lab instead.
